content.text: 2027 | -11 days: 10 hrs: 25 min: -9 sec Charitable Overview Click Here for 5050 Raffle Tournament Tournament The Valspar Championship brings some of the finest golfers in the world to the Tampa Bay area to compete on the Copperhead Course at Innisbrook Resort. Tee Times Find the tee times of your favorite golfer! Tee Times Scores & Earnings View past results from previous of the Valspar Championship, including scores, earnings and FedExCup points awarded. Scores & Earnings History The Copperheads have sponsored professional golf events in the Tampa Bay area since 1977, generating tens of millions of dollars in charitable donations.
